events.verdict: Harden (HOU) moves into Frazier's (NOP) path and initiates body contact that affects his SQBR. The body contact by Harden occurs prior to any contact initiated by Frazier.
Holiday (NOP) makes contact that is tactile in nature with Paul (HOU) as he sets the pick.
RLB shows Tucker (HOU) makes contact with Holiday's (NOP) arm affecting his dribble and SQBR.
There is not clear and conclusive video evidence determining if Tucker (HOU) makes contact with the ball before Holiday (NOP) retrieves it in the backcourt.

Paul (HOU) makes incidental contact with Holiday (NOP) during rebounding. The crew communicated with Replay Center official Scott Foster to determine who the ball went out of bounds off of. Initially, the ruling was awarded to NOP, and after review, the ruling was overturned to HOU ball.
Tucker (HOU) establishes himself in a screening position in Holiday's (NOP) path and does not deliver the contact as it is made.
Paul (HOU) has his hand against Holiday (NOP) as the shot is released, but does not apply any force as contact is made or affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Miller (NOP) makes marginal contact with Tucker (HOU) during rebounding that does not affect his ability to retrieve the ball.
Paul (HOU) is already in Frazier's (NOP) path as contact is made during the screen, which he does not deliver.
Gordon (HOU) shuffles his feet after receiving the inbound pass.
Harden (HOU) makes incidental contact with Frazier (NOP) after the ball is dribbled off of his foot.
LAR shows Harden (HOU) intentionally raises his right foot and makes contact with the ball during Frazier's (NOP) dribble.
Harden (HOU) makes marginal contact with Frazier (NOP) that does not affect his ability to pass.
Tucker (HOU) makes marginal contact with Holiday's (NOP) backside that does not affect his SQBR during the drive.
Holiday (NOP) makes marginal contact with Paul's (HOU) right wrist that does not affect his ability to maintain control of the ball.
LLS shows Tucker (HOU) makes contact with Frazier's (NOP) head prior to making contact with the ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Tucker (HOU) has his right foot out of bounds and fails to re-establish himself in bounds prior to making contact with the ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] Holiday (NOP) is in the lane for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Miller (NOP) initiates body/arm contact with Paul (HOU) that affects his ability to gain control of the rebound.
[Observable in enhanced video] Harden (HOU) lifts and re-plants his pivot foot to the floor at the start of his dribble.
Harden (HOU) wraps Holiday (NOP) with both arms during inbounding.
Paul (HOU) commits the take foul on Williams (NOP).
Holiday (NOP) and Paul (HOU) engage and disengage during rebounding.
[Observable in enhanced video] Tucker (HOU) enters the lane prior to the release of Williams' (NOP) free throw attempt.
Miller (NOP) maintains legal guarding position as he defends Harden (HOU) on the drive.
Harden (HOU) steps out of bounds while maintaining possession of the ball.
Miller (NOP) inbounds the basketball within five seconds.
Gordon (HOU) makes marginal contact with Miller (NOP) that does not restrict his FOM.
Tucker (HOU) commits the take foul on Frazier (NOP).
Holiday (NOP) makes marginal contact with Harden (HOU) during the rebound.
[Observable in enhanced video] Tucker (HOU) enters the lane prior to the release of Frazier's (NOP) free throw attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] RLB shows Holiday (NOP) receives the pass and gathers the ball on his right foot, which he slides prior to his left foot touching the floor.
Harden (HOU) briefly has his arm around Holiday's (NOP) midsection before correcting.
Frazier (NOP) moves into Harden's (HOU) space and initiates body contact as he releases the jump shot attempt.
Paul (HOU) commits the take foul on Holiday (NOP).
